name: @argentic/chest-check
description: chest check: the Chest's own validator, compiled to WebAssembly, judging a tool's repository before a Chest takes it. A development tool: install it as a devDependency; the runtime client is @argentic/chest-sdk.
author: Argentic

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build/test/*.test.js
